description: Sri Lanka Customs - Rates of Exchange effective from 13.05.2019 to 19.05.2019
reasoning: This gazette notification is issued under the Customs Ordinance (Chapter 235) and concerns the determination of official exchange rates for calculating customs duties and other charges. It is a regulatory instrument that establishes legal requirements for financial transactions related to customs, falling squarely under the "Legal/Regulatory Gazettes" category for regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements.
